name: basemind
description: Full AI context layer over MCP — tree-sitter code-map, document RAG (PDF/Office/HTML/email + OCR + reranker), shared agent memory, git history + blame + per-symbol diff. 300+ languages, 10+ coding-agent harnesses, content-addressed Fjall + LanceDB.
skillInstructions:
basemind is a tree-sitter code map + git context layer exposed over MCP as one tool per job: `code_outline`, `code_symbols`, `code_read`, `code_grep`, `code_search`, `code_refs`, `find_files`, `docs_search`, `git_log`, `git_blame`, `git_diff`, `memory_save`, `memory_search`, `index_status` and `index_rescan`. No tool takes a `mode`; an unknown argument is rejected, and every line number is 1-based. Prefer these tools over grep/read for structural and historical questions — they return paths, line numbers, and signatures, not file bodies.

- Instead of Kimi Code's `Grep` / `Glob` / `Read`: `code_symbols` for a definition, `code_refs` for call sites, callers, implementations and importers, `code_outline` for a file's structure, `find_files` to locate a file, and `code_grep` for text (literal unless `regex` is true).
- The code map holds code only: for markdown, config, data and PDF files call `docs_search`.
- For history, blame, status and diffs, call `git_log`, `git_blame` or `git_diff` instead of shelling out to `git` via `Bash`.
- Use Kimi Code's native `Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Bash`, `Grep`, and `Glob` for edits and anything basemind does not cover.
- After editing files, call `index_rescan` rather than restarting the server.
- Do not re-read a file basemind has already mapped — call `code_outline`, then `code_read` for only the symbol or span you need.

interface.shortDescription: Code-map MCP server for navigating large codebases
interface.longDescription: basemind indexes a repository with tree-sitter and exposes a structured code map — outlines, references, callers, history, blame, diff — over MCP. Designed for AI agents to navigate unfamiliar code without reading every file.
